full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs brought the suit, Title Suit No. 82 of 1989 in the second of Court of Assistant Judge, Narayanganj for correction of the registered sale deed executed by Osman Mia son of Ijjatullah in favour of their predecessor Ofazuddin. Their case in brief is this. The said Osman Mia and his brother Rawshan Ali were the C.S. recorded owners of the land measuring .29 acre comprised with-in C.S. Plot No. 754 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 90 of Mouza Bhuighar within Police Station Fatullah (described in the plaint as schedule Ka). There was an amicable partition between the two brothers. As a result Osman Mia got the said land in his share. In the years 1950 he transferred the same to his son-in-law Ofazuddin by the impugned registered kabala. Since the purchase Ofazuddin possessed the land through different bargaders and his name was also recorded in the relevant S.A. Khatian. The plaintiffs have now been possessing the said land as his successive heirs. In the year 1989 the plaintiffs came to learn for the first time that instead of the said Ka schedule land, the Ga schedule land had been wrongly inserted in the deed of Ofazuddin.
